tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get public information about the Vivaldo online store, its product categories and shipping.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search public Vivaldo products by query, for example: MacBook case, iPad case, keyboard cover, laptop sleeve.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of products to return, from 1 to 10.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query, for example: MacBook case, iPad case, laptop sleeve.

tools.name: get_product_by_handle
tools.description: Get public product details from Vivaldo by Shopify product handle.

params.name: handle
params.description: Product handle from the product URL.

tools.name: get_collection_products
tools.description: Get public products from a Vivaldo Shopify collection by collection handle.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of products to return, from 1 to 50.

params.name: collection_handle
params.description: Collection handle, for example ipad-cases or macbook-cases.
